literal: Hiding behind asceticism doing wrong things is like a hunter hiding behind a bush having trapped a bird.
translation: Committing evil deeds while hiding behind the guise of asceticism is like a hunter hiding behind a bush to snare a bird.
modern: தவக்கோலத்தில் மறைந்து கொண்டு தீய செயல்களைச் செய்வது, ஒரு வேடன் புதரின் பின்னால் மறைந்து கொண்டு பறவையைப் பிடிப்பதைப் போன்றது.
explanation: This couplet exposes the hypocrisy of false ascetics. It compares a person who uses the holy appearance of a sage to commit wicked deeds to a hunter who uses a bush for camouflage. Just as the hunter hides to deceive and trap an innocent bird, the false ascetic uses a pious disguise to deceive and exploit others. The powerful imagery highlights the predatory nature of such deceitful conduct.
